what: Dragging the horizontal card row leaves passed cards stacked in place at the left end, each shrinking 1→.45x and rotating 0→−8° over one card width (axis 75% center) — the next card slides over and covers the previous one. On release it glides with inertia (max 1s) and snaps to the nearest card position

options.rotate: Tilt when fully stacked (deg), default −8. At 0 only the stem shows
options.dur: Max inertia length after release (s), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=list]: Pull row (holds cards lined up horizontally)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One card — width + right margin (or row gap) makes one cell

note: Dragging is this part’s job, so horizontal drag is caught even on touch — touch-action: pan-y is set so vertical scroll isn’t blocked. Without InertiaPlugin it just snaps to the nearest cell with no inertia.

from.where: index.js TBP.overlap (first page lime Section “What's on the table?」 menu card row .t-ovl — original Osmo overlapping slider: data-scale .45 · data-rotate −8 · inertia maxDuration 1 · snap to cell)
